definitions.explanation: Literally a flag raised in rebellion. Almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す (to raise the flag of rebellion), meaning to rebel or revolt against authority.

examples.japanese: {反旗|はんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}す→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧。
⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主君|しゅくん}→主君：11712_shukun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反旗|はんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}した→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧。
examples.english: The retainer revolted against his lord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経営陣|けいえいじん}→経営陣：20535_keieijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反旗|はんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}し→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧、⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The employees revolted against management and demanded reforms.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反旗|はんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}す→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧ (raise the flag of rebellion, revolt)

USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set expression {反旗|はんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}す→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧. While the literal meaning involves warfare, it is commonly used figuratively for any act of open defiance against authority — a politician breaking from their party, employees challenging management, or anyone publicly opposing the established order.
